sinkhorn — COLORTRANSPORT transport op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × matrix → transport_plan

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.sinkhorn(a, b, cost, reg=0.05, n_iter=2000, tol=1e-09) (to call the implementation directly, import colortransport; colortransport.sinkhorn(a, b, cost, reg=0.05, n_iter=2000, tol=1e-09); from the registry, opscolortransport.get("sinkhorn"))

Usage

The entropically regularised optimal-transport plan (Cuturi, NIPS 2013).

It is not the exact solution. Making reg smaller brings it closer to the exact solution, but at the same time it becomes numerically unstable (the exponentials underflow). That lowering reg shrinks the gap to the exact solution is itself pinned by a test.

Returns

ndarray

A transport plan of shape (n, m). Row and column sums match a / b

(up to tol). If it does not converge, RuntimeError -- returning the last iteration

without convergence would silently send a plan whose row sums do not add up downstream.
